text:
maria: Quick async check — onboarding zeta-13b weights. HF path is huggingface.co/org/zeta-13b and we need to mirror to s3 for serving. Who owns the presign role and the manifest entry?

ashwin: I can take the presign role update. Do we want a short TTL (1h) for CI or a longer one for manual handoffs?

kevin: For the mirror job, set presign TTL to 15m for automated ingest, 2h for manual debug. Prefer shorter by default.

maria: Ok. Two quick gotchas I hit locally: tokenizer pads with 1 at the end (pad token id 1) and the hf tokenizer.json has a different special_tokens_map key than our loader expects. That caused off-by-one in eval.

lisa: Noted — please add a note in the manifest metadata about tokenizer.pad_id and special_tokens_map. We've had regressions when teams assume pad_id==0.

jen: On IAM: deploy-bot currently presigns with role arn:aws:iam::123456:role/model-presigner. We probably want a scoped role for zeta-13b with a condition on s3 prefix. Example policy snippet I used in staging:```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": "s3:GetObject",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-models/zeta-13b/*",
      "Condition": {"StringLike": {"s3:prefix": "zeta-13b/*"}}
    }
  ]
}
```

ashwin: That looks good. Also add a condition for aws:SourceArn if presign requests are coming from a specific lambda or step function.

kevin: Checksum plan: mirror job should write a manifest.json with fields: file, size, sha256. CI validation runs sha256sum and compares. Example command: `sha256sum zeta-13b-weights.pt`

maria: Our registry CI failed because the HF export uses a streaming blob and the size field was missing in the manifest — CI rejected it. I patched the mirrorer to capture Content-Length and include it.

lisa: Action items: 1) ashwin scope role + set ttl policy 2) kevin add sha256 validation step to mirror job 3) jen update manifest schema to include tokenizer metadata and size 4) maria add a quick README about pad_id quirk.

ashwin: I'll create a PR for the role and attach the IAM policy. Expect link in ~1h.

jen: I'll update manifest schema PR against registry repo. Quick question — do we put tokenizer.json in the same s3 prefix or reference huggingface? Some infra needs local tokenizer for deterministic loading.

maria: Put tokenizer.json alongside weights (s3://redwood-models/zeta-13b/tokenizer.json) and include a hf_source field pointing back to huggingface. That way serving picks local file but we keep provenance.

kevin: Will implement sha256 step and fail the mirror if checksum mismatch. Also add a fallback mirror attempt if initial GET returns chunked transfer without content-length — try `aws s3 cp` after uploading to a temporary object to get size.

lisa: Small ops note — rolling canary should use quantized fp16 variant if available, we need to record quantization_profile in manifest so runtime picks the right kernel.

maria: Good call. Manifest keys to lock: files[], tokenizer_meta, quantization_profile, owner, provenance.hf_ref.

deploy-bot: mirror-job(zeta-13b) started by jen — job id mj-2026-03-18-07. ETA ~12m :construction: 

jen: pinging to link PRs once ready. I'll also add a short entry to the onboarding checklist so next time it's less manual.

kevin: Quick test plan: after mirror completes, run small smoke generation with maxlength=16 and verify no tokenization mismatch against huggingface baseline.

maria: Thanks all — putting items in a single kanban card and assigning. If anyone wants to pair on the tokenizer edge-case, ping me. :thumbsup:
